HOWLUND WINDOW MAKER 89 - SANITIZATION REPORT
==============================================

Source: /mnt/data/hwnd_window.zip
Source SHA-256: a1c1cb62179abdc6cbb1c5fc8a4fcc571ef5c3f60a530d47be67ca6ea3e30e63

PUBLIC API
----------
Old namespace: HWND_* / hwnd_*
New namespace: HOWM89_* / howm89_*
Reason: HWND is a native Win32 window handle type and is no longer used by portable public API.

PROTOCOL89
----------
Portable core:
  malloc/calloc/realloc/free : 0
  float/double               : 0
  long long                  : 0
  int64_t/uint64_t           : 0
  stdint.h                   : 0
  fixed-capacity windows     : YES (default 16)
  Q16 opacity/scale          : YES

Maintained built-in backend sources:
  explicit heap APIs         : 0
  C float/double keywords    : 0
  explicit 64-bit types      : 0

OS-native ABI types remain inside platform adapters only.

ARCHITECTURE
------------
Portable core does not auto-detect or require an OS backend.
User may register any HOWM89_BackendVTable + backend_user.
Built-in backends are optional convenience modules.
Default-backend auto selection is optional and OFF by default in CMake.

BACKENDS PRESERVED
------------------
Windows 32/64  -> backends/win32
Linux X11 32/64 -> backends/x11
macOS family -> backends/cocoa
Optional convenience selector -> backends/auto
Historical per-bitness locations documented under backends/by_system_backend.

RESPONSIBILITY CLEANUP
----------------------
Removed logical/internal render-size ownership from window library.
HOWM89 creates/manages native windows only.
Render resolution belongs to video configuration/provider layers.

CMake core-only build                        PASS
CMake optional X11 backend build             PASS
legacy public HWND-like names in core        0
